message: The dependency '{0}' in type '{1}' cannot be handled because no dependency injection framework is registered. Register a framework by calling the RegisterFramework method from ConfigureDependencyInjection in a fabric.
rationale: DependencyInjectionOptions.TryGetFramework reports LAMA0701 only when the list of registered frameworks is empty, but the message does not say so: it reads like LAMA0702 and gives no way forward. The title already states the cause correctly.
